title: SUMM-RE: A corpus of French meeting-style conversations
why_promising: Primary non-singing French conversational production recorded by Aix-Marseille/LINAGORA. The public corpus is CC BY-SA 4.0. Dev/test comprise roughly 24-25 hours of manually transcribed and aligned speech; records expose speaker/audio IDs plus segment timestamps and word-level timestamps, while the train split is explicitly automatic and therefore non-core under current rules.
open_question: Review whether manual correction/aligning of dev/test includes exhaustive human verification of word timing or only transcript text. If admissible, ingest ONLY the documented manually transcribed/aligned dev/test layers; exclude automatic train alignments. Inventory parquet structure, speaker/meeting metadata, segment and word timestamps, and any annotation provenance before promotion.
